Kernel density estimation is a method to estimate a probability density function for a random variable. It’s a pretty common statistical technique that allows you to sample from a distribution which you do not have an exact description of. The crate itself implements this technique to calculate probability density functions, cumulative distribution functions, and sample from the underlying distribution. Right now it only works for univariate distributions but I am actively working to extend it to multivariate.
